run `npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init` from the app's folder first and follow what it prints: it signs the user in and stores a key for the project, so nobody copies one by hand. When the user approved in the browser, that also signed the ElevenLabs CLI in, so don't run `elevenlabs auth login` after it. When they added the key by hand (on a remote machine), or a CLI command answers 401, load the env file into the command instead, for example `(set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest agents list)`; the CLI reads a `.env` on its own.
